description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph, which automatically inserts paragraph tags into text based on double-spacing, as part of the HTMLPurifier library's injection system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph
classes.description: An injector class that automatically adds paragraph tags to text based on double-spacing, enhancing HTML content formatting.

methods.name: _pStart
methods.description:
Creates and returns a new start token for a paragraph (

) with error handling armor.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes text tokens to determine if paragraph tags should be inserted based on double newlines.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles element tokens to insert paragraph tags appropriately within the HTML structure.

methods.name: _splitText
methods.description: Splits text into paragraph tokens based on double newlines and manages start/end paragraph tokens.

methods.name: _isInline
methods.description: Checks if a token is inline and allowed within paragraph tags.

methods.name: _pLookAhead
methods.description: Looks ahead in the token stream to decide if a paragraph tag needs to be inserted.

methods.name: _checkNeedsP
methods.description: Determines if a token requires an inline paragraph start based on its content.
